latin: Exponere in Fabula Critiae per quinque partus, quinque formas corporis omnino est inconueniens.
translation: To interpret the five births in the Tale of Critias as referring to five bodily forms is altogether unfitting.
translation_note: 'quinque partus' (five births/offspring) refers to the five successive human races or generations narrated in the myth of the Critias/Atlantis material Pico groups under that title.
